history.recommendation_text: The Board recommended that the Administration coordinate with the United Nations Foundation to determine how the parties to the relationship agreement can coordinate the Foundation’s investment policy to ensure that funds are used more efficiently for United Nations causes.
history.administration_response: The United Nations Foundation has provided the United Nations Office for Partnerships with documentation on its good governance policies, which detail its investment policies as endorsed by the Foundation’s board of directors. This documentation has been transmitted by the Office to the Board. The Office believes this documentation fulfils the Board’s recommendation and requests its closure.
history.board_assessment: Given that the United Nations Foundation has provided the United Nations Office for Partnerships with documentation on its good governance policies, which detail its investment policies as endorsed by the Foundation’s board of directors, the Board considers this recommendation implemented.
